Trace, implement and test: Max Profit

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class MaxProfit {
    public static int maxProfit(int[] prices) {
        int maxProfit = 0;
        int minPrice = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        int i = 0;

        while (i < prices.length) {
            if (prices[i] < minPrice) {
                minPrice = prices[i];
            } else if (prices[i] - minPrice > maxProfit) {
                maxProfit = prices[i] - minPrice;
            }
            i++;
        }
        return maxProfit;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] prices = {7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4};
        System.out.println(maxProfit(prices));
    }
}
